body:
The Core borrowed-record validator is merged in #6307. The environmental runtime still requires a contiguous assignment even when computation payloads already reside in firmware.

Scope: the runtime's existing fixed table compiler and its conformance controls. Add a borrowed-record entrance using the same Core validator and the same table builder. Preserve current schema eligibility, layout checks, computation inventory, startup ordering, routing, Host Call admission, refusal behavior, and allocation bounds. No Body, authority, transport, firmware installation, or execution-kernel replacement is included.

Acceptance:
- Contiguous and borrowed inputs produce equivalent owned tables without allocation.
- Existing production-kernel sensor/observation conformance executes the borrowed tables after preparation payloads are dropped.
- Stale Boot, corrupted integrity, re-sealed layout substitution and capacity refusal match the existing entrance without allocation.
- Owning runtime tests and strict lint pass on current dev. Retain evidence and submit a small PR against dev.


### Independent focused verification (2026-10-23)

An independent clean checkout of PR #6314 at `74b54ea9ed14042504f7ac44bd4a5e11388b9d0e` passed all 22 owning runtime tests and strict all-target Clippy. The [raw logs and source-bound receipt](https://github.com/dancxjo/conduit/tree/4f83ed52003d5d60b95db21327c1867c53b5b076/bodies/environment/evidence/2026-10-23-independent-runtime-records) are retained on an independently verified origin evidence branch. The broad workspace host lane does not substitute for this separate Cargo workspace.

Candidate, actual merged delivery identity and relevant descendant Integration remain pending. No device, firmware, physical or stable-release acceptance is claimed.


### Closure audit: observation execution bridge still required

The delivered #6314 tree passed its Candidate and full Integration (25 successful jobs). Current combined dev also passes all 29 owning runtime tests and strict all-target Clippy. The separate workspace proof remains distinct from broad Integration.

The acceptance audit found one specific gap: sensor/capture controls execute the borrowed-input tables after helper-local payloads/descriptors drop, but the observation conformance test still constructed its scheduler tables directly from lowered Source. This issue remains open until both paths are proved.

Root is preparing a one-file test bridge on `fix/6313-borrowed-observation-20261023`, reusing the existing assignment/table helper and assigned pulse-owner admission. It preserves all seven observation scenarios, semantic quantities/effects, 32 value slots, 38,912 value bytes and existing sign bounds. Independent static review found no actionable issue; actual tests/lint and delivery remain pending. No production runtime, firmware, physical or stable-release capability is added.


### Verified bridge held for queue capacity

The final two-test-file bridge is pushed at [`874a611f9b1bdb239c7b422a94aae3471df1dfbb`](https://github.com/dancxjo/conduit/commit/874a611f9b1bdb239c7b422a94aae3471df1dfbb) on `fix/6313-borrowed-observation-20261023`, based on dev `3b3f539ae`. All 29 owning runtime tests, strict all-target Clippy and supported preflight (345 CI-tool tests plus workflow/lock checks) passed at that exact clean source. Independent source review found no actionable issue.

Both sensor and seven-scenario observation conformance now feed the returned owned borrowed-input tables to the existing production kernel after preparation payloads/descriptors drop. The final bridge retains the original selected pulse-owner binding. Observation uses an explicit 38,912-byte declared-projection ceiling within its existing fixture capacity; sensor preparation retains its 16-KiB projection profile. Scheduler value slots, arena bytes, signs and production grants are unchanged. Two rejected fixture-bound variants and the missing-actionlint environment failure remain beside the successful source-bound proofs in the [complete retained packet](https://github.com/dancxjo/conduit/tree/c6e08b231f413d16e9c8754220501d116c6f038c/bodies/environment/runtime/evidence/2026-10-23-borrowed-observation). The 19,465-byte refusal was declared runtime projection state, not encoded input size.

This preparation is held without an additional PR while #6326 and #6327 occupy the two-PR queue. Candidate, merged delivery and relevant post-merge checks remain before closure. No firmware, physical or stable-release acceptance is claimed.


### Current-dev held proof refresh (2026-10-24 UTC)

The already-prepared two-test-file bridge is now cleanly merged onto dev `c40764ccf645414dcd155ac5e2c8c48136005ab2`, at published source `85520586a1d11f48abe68b602cf058c2f548a6b9`. Independent source-object checks verify the environmental runtime tree is unchanged from previously reviewed source874a611f9; the product delta against current dev remains exactly the observation test and assignment support helper. All29 owning tests, strict all-target Clippy and supported preflight (345 CI-tool tests) were actually rerun and passed at855. [The refreshed logs, source-bound receipt and clean-merge audit](https://github.com/dancxjo/conduit/tree/6fb01304205a4ec71df375f8616841ec3b79c7c4/bodies/environment/runtime/evidence/2026-10-23-borrowed-observation-refresh/85520586a) are retained on a remote-verified evidence branch. Historical negatives and independent review remain at their original linked source.

This proof bridge stays outside the PR queue while omnibus#6339 proceeds. It is published and ready for admission when a review slot clears; no Candidate, accepted delivery, applicable Integration or issue closure is claimed yet.
title: Admit borrowed assignment records through the existing runtime table compiler
